pairs.why: The two are nearly identical, but A's face wrinkles are a little softer and closer to the smooth soft-toy finish of the real boxing gloves and chair, while B has slightly busier fold detail.
B has more wrinkle lines carved into the face and ears, which is the too-textured look the lessons reject; A keeps the smoother, rounder finish of the real cards.
B's fur and face are slightly cleaner and smoother, closer to the soft matte-plastic finish of the real cards, though the difference is very small.
A has fewer, softer wrinkles and a smoother body surface, while B adds the denser fold detail the lessons rate as too textured.
B's separate grass tufts scattered over the lawn and its extra dangling tag make busier surface detail, while A's ground and coat stay smoother, like the real cards.
A's face is smoother than B's heavily wrinkled face, though A's scattered grass tufts add some texture, so this is close.
A's rounder, smoother face with fewer creases matches the soft, simplified forms of the real cards better than B's more detailed wrinkles.
A's lawn is a smoother, plainer green with softer coat shading, while B adds separate grass tufts; otherwise they are nearly the same.
